comparison.objective: Refit a long wardrobe rail between one closed and one open support.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually tilt a long part, insert one end, swing the other end down, level, and release.
comparison.success_condition: Both ends are supported, the rail is within 1 degree of level, still, and released.
comparison.reason: Long-part tilt-in insertion does not test fine hex-tool manipulation, captive locking, setting preservation, or dynamic response optimization.
